mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(ert.`id`) FROM `emergency_rule_condition` erc INNER JOIN `emergency_rule_condition_device` ercd ON erc.`emergency_rule_id` = ercd.`emergency_rule_id` INNER JOIN `emergency_rule_condition_exp` ercx on erc.`emergency_rule_id` = ercx.`emergency_rule_id` INNER JOIN `emergency_rule_time` ert ON erc.`emergency_rule_id` = ert.`emergency_rule_id` WHERE erc.`condition_type` = 'CUSTOM_RULE_CONDITION'
and erc.`emergency_rule_id` != #{emergencyId}
AND erc.`device_model_id` in
#{modelId}
AND ercd.`device_id` IN
#{deviceId}
AND
( ercx.`prop_code` = #{emergencyRuleConditionExp.propCode} and ercx.`op` = #{emergencyRuleConditionExp.op} and ercx.`oprand` = #{emergencyRuleConditionExp.oprand} )
AND
(
(#{emergencyRuleTimePO.startTime} <= ert.`start_time` and ert.`end_time` <= #{emergencyRuleTimePO.endTime}) or (
#{emergencyRuleTimePO.startTime} <= ert.`start_time` and ert.`start_time` <= #{emergencyRuleTimePO.endTime}) or (
#{emergencyRuleTimePO.startTime} >= ert.`start_time` and #{emergencyRuleTimePO.startTime} <= ert.end_time) )
